📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing`
This is occurrence #3 in the last ~2 weeks (2026-06-20, 2026-07-03, 2026-07-04) — but this one deviates from the first two.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Integrations` (`@connect` / `#team-connect`)
Playbook: Confirm sibling P1 EDA monitors (296632224 event-ingest, 296636101 Kafka-produce) first; if OK, check service:eda_consumer status:error (expect 0); escalate if this occurrence's longer/unresolved shape repeats.
Open Jira: none

Source alerts (1 total, DD-sourced — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP):
  • https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466 (last_triggered 2026-07-04T10:21:26Z)

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466 (No Data since 10:21:26Z, still open at scan time)
  • DD metric (AMQP consumer, RCA): sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:eda_consumer,env:prod} — data through ~09:49:30Z then zero through 11:10Z (~80min+ gap, still open). Query: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aeda_consumer%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1783157400&end=1783163400
  • Deviation from prior 2 (benign) occurrences: sibling P1 monitors 296632224/296636101 briefly tripped 09:55–10:05:30Z (~10.5min gap) then recovered; upstream ingest/Kafka traffic has been healthy since ~10:05Z while eda_consumer's AMQP-publish metric stayed at zero throughout — decoupled from a simple shared quiet period.
  • eda_consumer status:error logs: 0 hits 09:30–11:10Z (DD Logs query)
  • Full write-up: docs/investigations/2026-07-04-065da57bed22502b.md

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-method-ui-grid-dropdown-performance-test-nodata`
This is occurrence #15 since 2026-05-02 — first-ever notify on this entry (housekeeping confirmation, not a new finding).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `unmapped` (non-prod QA synthetics, no prod-service owner)
Playbook: team:qa-tagged synthetic browser-performance checks (Day run / Day run 2 / Evening run / Midnight run / Release Run) chronically go No Data overnight; 15 occurrences since 2026-05-02, zero correlation with any real production signal to date.
Open Jira: none

Source alerts (3 family members this cycle, DD-sourced — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP):
  • https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/121308660 (Day run, last_triggered 2026-07-04T00:01:01Z)
  • https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/133625690 (Day run 2, last_triggered 2026-07-04T00:01:20Z)
  • https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/123495492 (Evening run, last_triggered 2026-07-04T04:00:12Z)

Evidence:
  • DD monitors: all three above, all `No Data`, all team:qa non-prod
  • This-window concentration: no co-firing prod-service monitor found in the same window (consistent with 14 prior occurrences)
  • This is a one-time notify — this pattern will not be posted again unless it hits the every-10th-occurrence resurface or a co-firing production signal ever appears
  • Full write-up: docs/investigations/2026-07-04-7af5f5c357f25a6f.md
